bestaetigen.title: SmartHeat found
bestaetigen.description: The Heizungsbrücke add-on (device {geraet}) is ready. Connect it to your SmartHeat account now?

anmelden.title: Connect to SmartHeat
anmelden.description: A new code is needed to connect the device to your SmartHeat account. Submit to request it; you confirm it in the SmartHeat portal. No password is entered here.

schon_eingerichtet.title: Already set up
schon_eingerichtet.description: This device already controls the installation {anlage}. Show SmartHeat in Home Assistant again?

data_description.anlage: The installation of your SmartHeat account that this device is going to control.

ersetzen.title: Replace device
ersetzen.description: The installation {anlage} is attached to another device. This device replaces it; the learned values are kept.

inventur_zeit.title: Inventory
inventur_zeit.description: Home Assistant did not deliver the inventory in time. Submit to try again.

data_description.integration: The Home Assistant integration that talks to your heating, for example the one of your heating manufacturer.

data_description.kreise: The heating circuits SmartHeat is going to control. Choose at least one and at most four; heating circuit 1 is required.
data_description.profil: The type of your heating installation. It decides which values SmartHeat reads and which settings it may change.

data_description.hebelsatz: The settings of your heating that SmartHeat is allowed to change. Choose the variant that matches your heating.

abo.title: Subscription for heating circuit {nummer}
abo.description: Choose the subscription that carries heating circuit {nummer}. Without a choice the circuit stays detected and is not set up. {abos}

data_description.abo_id: The subscription of your SmartHeat account that pays for this heating circuit. Each subscription can carry one heating circuit.

raeume.title: Heating circuit {nummer}: room
raeume.description: Name of the room, its room sensors and the desired temperature entity (e.g. the thermostat in the living room) of heating circuit {nummer}. A second room only measures.

data_description.raum_name: A short name for the room, up to 40 characters.
data_description.raumfuehler: Temperature sensors that measure the room temperature. Choose one to eight sensors per heating circuit.
data_description.room_target: The entity in which you set the desired temperature of this room, for example the thermostat. Exactly one room provides it.
data_description.raum_soll: The desired room temperature of this room that is offered at the start.
data_description.kontroll_name: Name of a second room that is only measured and does not provide the desired temperature. Leave empty if there is none.
data_description.kontroll_fuehler: Temperature sensors of the second room. Fill in together with its name.

anlagenwerte.title: Heating circuit {nummer}: values
anlagenwerte.description: Prefilled from the heating integration; please check.

data_description.curve: The entity that holds the slope of the heating curve. SmartHeat adjusts it.
data_description.room_setpoint: The entity of the heating that holds the room setpoint or the zone setpoint.
data_description.level: The entity that holds the level (parallel shift) of the heating curve.
data_description.heat_limit: The entity that holds the outdoor temperature above which the heating switches off. SmartHeat adjusts it.
data_description.min_flow: The entity that holds the lowest flow temperature of the heating.
data_description.mode_select: The entity with which the operating mode or heating program of the heating is chosen.
data_description.setpoint_comfort: The entity that holds the room setpoint in comfort mode.
data_description.setpoint_setback: The entity that holds the room setpoint in setback mode.
data_description.outdoor_temp: The outdoor temperature sensor. SmartHeat bases its control on it.
data_description.flow_temperature: Measured flow temperature of the heating. Optional; it only completes the displayed values.
data_description.flow_setpoint: The flow temperature the heating aims for. Optional.
data_description.return_temperature: Measured return temperature of the heating. Optional.
data_description.operating_mode: The current operating mode as a reading. Optional.
data_description.system_water_pressure: Water pressure of the installation. Optional.
data_description.efficiency_ratio: The efficiency value the manufacturer reports. Optional.
data_description.generator_hours: Operating hours of the heat generator. Optional.
data_description.generator_starts: Number of starts of the heat generator. Optional.
data_description.generator_state: Status of the heat generator. Optional.
data_description.energy_electrical_heating: Electrical energy used for heating. Optional.
data_description.energy_electrical_dhw: Electrical energy used for hot water. Optional.
data_description.energy_primary_heating: Primary energy used for heating. Optional.
data_description.energy_primary_dhw: Primary energy used for hot water. Optional.
data_description.energy_thermal_heating: Thermal energy delivered for heating. Optional.
data_description.energy_thermal_dhw: Thermal energy delivered for hot water. Optional.

data_description.benachrichtigung: The phones that receive push notifications from SmartHeat. Leave empty for none.
data_description.hinweise_aus: Kinds of notes that appear in Home Assistant only and are not sent as push notifications.
data_description.batterien: Battery entities SmartHeat watches and reports when they run low.

geraet_entfernen.title: Remove device
geraet_entfernen.description: SmartHeat resets the heating of installation {anlage} to the last learned values and releases the device.

progress.warten: Open [{link}]({link_komplett}), sign in and confirm the code **{anmeldecode}**. The link already contains the code; compare it with the one shown here. This page continues by itself as soon as you have confirmed the code in the portal. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
progress.warten_eigener_server:
Open [{link}]({link_komplett}), sign in and confirm the code **{anmeldecode}**. The link already contains the code; compare it with the one shown here. This page continues by itself as soon as you have confirmed the code in the portal. The code is valid for 10 minutes.

This setup talks to **{server}** (option bootstrap_url of the add-on), not to the SmartHeat default server.
progress.inventur: Searching Home Assistant for the heating …
progress.einrichten: The device is applying the settings …

error.uebernahme_gesperrt: Claiming is locked after too many failed attempts: {grund}
error.uebernahme_fehlgeschlagen: The device could not be claimed: {grund}
error.anmeldung_gebunden: The device could not be claimed with this sign-in: {grund}
error.cannot_connect: The SmartHeat service cannot be reached.
error.sitzung_abgelaufen: The sign-in has expired. Submit to get a new code.
error.erneut_anmelden: The confirmation in the portal is more than ten minutes old. Submit to get a new code.
error.code_abgelaufen: The code has expired. Submit to get a new one.
error.wrong_domain: This entity does not fit this field.
error.zone_is_room_target: The desired temperature cannot be a value of the heating itself.
error.entity_wrong_integration: Does not belong to the chosen heating integration.
error.entity_wrong_installation: Belongs to another installation of this integration.
error.kreis_nicht_entfernbar: A heating circuit that is already set up cannot be removed here.
error.kreise_anzahl: Select one to four heating circuits.
error.nummer_doppelt: A heating circuit number was used twice.
error.kreis_doppelt: A heating circuit was selected twice.
error.weg_gemischt: All heating circuits must come from the same heating integration.
error.abo_doppelt: This subscription is already used for another heating circuit.
error.kreis_belegt: This heating circuit already has a subscription.
error.abo_nicht_verbindbar: The subscription could not be connected to the heating circuit.
error.name: Please give the room a name (up to 40 characters).
error.soll_quelle: Exactly one room must provide the desired temperature.
error.fuehler_zahl: Select one to eight room sensors per heating circuit.
error.fuehler_form: A room sensor entry is invalid.
error.keine_raeume: At least one room is required.

abort.kein_supervisor: SmartHeat needs Home Assistant with add-ons (Supervisor).
abort.addon_fehler: The Heizungsbrücke add-on could not be installed, started or checked. Please try again; details are in the log.
abort.addon_veraltet: Please update the Heizungsbrücke add-on to 1.0.0 and then start the setup again.
abort.addon_mehrdeutig: The Heizungsbrücke add-on is installed more than once. Please remove one installation and try again.
abort.bootstrap_url_ungueltig: The bootstrap_url option of the Heizungsbrücke add-on is invalid. Please correct or clear it and start the setup again.
abort.repository_mehrdeutig: The SmartHeat repository is registered more than once in the add-on store. Please remove the duplicate entries and start the setup again.
abort.fremde_heizungsbruecke: A Heizungsbrücke from another repository is installed. Please remove it and start the setup again.
abort.nachweis_fehlt: The Heizungsbrücke add-on did not answer. Is it running and up to date? Please start or update it and start the setup again.
abort.nachweis_abgelehnt: The SmartHeat service did not accept the proof of the device. Please check date and time of Home Assistant and that the device is not blocked or released, then start the setup again.
abort.code_abgelehnt: The code was rejected in the portal. Please start the setup again.
abort.server_veraltet: The SmartHeat server does not know the setup for Home Assistant (outdated server version?).
abort.portal_bestaetigung: This step takes effect only after the owner has confirmed it in the SmartHeat portal. Please confirm it there and start the setup again.
abort.keine_discovery: The add-on did not report. Please check the add-on log.
abort.geraet_nicht_gemeldet: The Heizungsbrücke add-on does not report this device (any more). Please start the setup again.
abort.keine_anlage: The account has no free, active installation. An installation that still runs on the previous access is moved by a separate step.
abort.inventur_fehler: The installation could not be checked: {grund}
abort.nicht_unterstuetzt: For {integration} there is no complete heating circuit or no released installation profile.
abort.rolle_ohne_kandidaten: Home Assistant reported no suitable entity for {rolle}. Please check the heating integration and start the setup again.
abort.einrichten_zeit: The device did not answer in time. Is the Heizungsbrücke add-on running? Please start the setup again.
abort.keine_konfiguration: The device does not report a configuration yet. Please try again in a few minutes.
abort.entfernen_laeuft: The entry has been removed; the SmartHeat service releases the device as soon as it can be reached.
abort.entfernt: The device has been removed and released.
abort.cannot_connect: The SmartHeat service cannot be reached.
abort.geraet_unbekannt: The device does not belong to this account or is locked ({grund}).
abort.unknown: Unexpected error; details are in the log.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new mapping has been applied.

options.vaillant_vrc720: Heating curve, zone setpoint and heating limit
options.weishaupt_wwp: Heating curve, room setpoint and summer/winter switch-over
options.weishaupt_wwp_basis: Room setpoint only (without heating curve and summer/winter switch-over)

state.soll: Room too cold compared to the target

wunsch_ungueltig.message: The desired temperature must be a number.

kreis_nicht_gemeldet.message: The system does not report this heating circuit at the moment, so SmartHeat cannot pass on the target temperature.

thermostat_aus.message: The thermostat is switched off. SmartHeat accepts no target temperature while it is off.

addon_nicht_bereit.message: The add-on is not running or not responding, so SmartHeat cannot pass on the target temperature. Please wait until the add-on is back.

integration_veraltet.message: The SmartHeat integration is older than the add-on and cannot read its messages, so it cannot pass on the target temperature. Please update the integration.

addon_veraltet.message: The SmartHeat add-on is older than the integration and not understood by it, so the integration cannot pass on the target temperature. Please update the add-on.

geraet_doppelt.title: SmartHeat is running twice
geraet_doppelt.description: {text} Please stop the second Home Assistant instance with the same add-on (e.g. a restored backup).

konfiguration_abgelehnt.title: SmartHeat: setting rejected
konfiguration_abgelehnt.description: The add-on rejected the new setting: {text} Please check it under SmartHeat → Reconfigure.

integration_veraltet.title: SmartHeat: update the integration
integration_veraltet.description: The add-on is newer than this integration and speaks a version it does not read. The values are not shown until the integration is updated to at least version {mindest_integration}. Settings → Devices & services → HACS → SmartHeat → Update.

integration_veraltet_ohne_version.title: SmartHeat: update the integration
integration_veraltet_ohne_version.description: The add-on is newer than this integration and speaks a version it does not read. The values are not shown until the integration is updated. Settings → Devices & services → HACS → SmartHeat → Update.

addon_veraltet.title: SmartHeat: update the add-on
addon_veraltet.description: The add-on is older than this integration and speaks a version it no longer reads. The values are not shown until the add-on is updated. Settings → Add-ons → Heizungsbrücke → Update.

common.warning_stale: No update for more than 6 hours: {entities}
common.warning_deviation: More than 3 K away from the other room sensors: {entities}
common.warning_write_role_unmatched: Not recognised as part of the chosen heating circuit: {entities}. SmartHeat will write to these entities.
